title: Are LLMs Ready to Replace Bangla Annotators?
findings: The study found that most Large Language Models struggle to reliably classify identity-sensitive hate speech in Bangla. Specifically for religious categories, models exhibited poor performance, with F1 scores for the 'Muslim' category ranging from approximately 24% to 47% and for the 'Hindu' category from 20% to 47%. This highlights a significant limitation in handling content related to religious identities in a low-resource language context.
